meta.name: Sky and horizon — Devashish Juyal portfolio
meta.description: Colours sampled from the owner's hero photo: sky navy, cloud grey-lavender and horizon orange. Plain nav bar, no neumorphism or glass. Accent = clickable. One featured project at double size with real product screens.
source_references: User brief 2026-11-04: neumorphism + glass hybrid, light/dark toggle, minimalistic palette, recruiter-first, agent-graph hero console
Revision 2026-11-04: user asked for super minimalistic; removed hero console, metrics, chips, case studies, orbs

Revision 2026-11-16: step 2 of the move toward an expressive, personal portfolio (inspired by dharmashah.com structure, not its palette or fonts). Palette echoes the golden-hour light in the photography section.

Revision 2026-11-16b: closer to dharmashah.com structure for a product-minded audience (site still says "AI engineer"): full-screen photo hero from the owner's own sunrise shot, centred big section titles, experience as an outcome table, Fun stuff section with a drifting photo strip on a deep navy band.

Revision 2026-11-16c: implemented a design critique: removed template tells (glass pill nav, shadowed circles, mono kickers), photo-derived palette, shorter hero with proof strip, Work above Projects, labelled expandable project rows with screenshots and metrics, captioned dawn-to-night photo strip with lightbox, closing note and footer in the navy band, static reading notes with search.

Revision 2026-11-16d: hero uses the star-trail ring artwork at night (now the default theme) and its colour negative by day; hero colours and scrims are per mode and measured at 4.9:1 or better from 360px to 2560px.

color.palette_type: warm neutrals with a single accent

accent.role: links and controls only (5.4:1 light, 8.2:1 dark); #F59A5C is the horizon orange from the hero photo

neutral.usage: Light: #F5F3EF page, #ECE9E3 hover surface. Dark: #0C1631 page, #13204A hover surface, #F3EEE6 ink, #A2A5B8 tertiary (7.3:1). Navy band #0E1F45 (#07102A in dark).

surface.band: #0E1F45 navy band for the closing note, photo strip and footer

color.contrast_strategy: Every text token is at least 4.5:1 on its background in both themes (checked with the WCAG formula); figures are in the comment at the top of style.css.

font_families.heading: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif — 500; italic only for the role line
font_families.mono: 'JetBrains Mono' — dates and metrics only, tabular figures

typography.pairing_logic: Serif headings, all left-aligned without trailing full stops; Inter at 16px body, 14px secondary, 12px labels; mono only for dates and metrics.

layout.grid: single column 760px (880px above 1600px); hero, proof strip and navy band full-bleed
layout.alignment: everything shares one left edge, headings included

shape.borders: hairlines only around images and badges
shape.dividers: none inside sections; spacing groups items

motion.philosophy: tactile: elements press in on click, rise slightly on hover; nothing bounces

components.button_style: One solid cream pill (Email me); everything else is an underlined text link.
components.card_style: Project rows: thumbnail, year · domain, badge, title, summary, live/code links, a right-aligned metric and a labelled Details button (aria-expanded) that unfolds Problem / What I built / Result beside a screenshot. The first project is featured at double size with its screen.
components.navigation_pattern: Plain bar: name, Work, Projects, Fun stuff, Reading notes, and a text Day / Night switch. Light text over the hero photo, solid page-coloured bar after it.
components.inputs: Tag filters are plain mono text; the active tag is inset.
components.hero: About 62% of the viewport. Night (default): ring artwork, cream text, near-black scrim. Day: the artwork's colour negative, navy text, white scrim. A top scrim keeps the nav legible over the arc. Portrait, name, role, employer line, pitch, Email me and quiet LinkedIn/GitHub links.
components.experience: Current employer as a heading with a two-column what/result table; earlier roles, education and recognition as hairline-ruled rows.

visual_language.contrast_level: low surface contrast, high text contrast
visual_language.ornamentation: none; depth appears only on interaction and on a few controls

composition.hierarchy_method: size + weight + depth (extruded = actionable, inset = data)

imagery.photography: hero day and night photos; a captioned strip of 25 photos ordered dawn to night that drifts, can be dragged, swiped or arrowed, stops on request or under reduced motion, and opens a larger view

examples: Applied AI engineer. Data Scientist at Tech Observer.

overview.fallback_strategy: no animation beyond 220ms transitions; prefers-reduced-motion disables them

visual_effects.composite_notes: The only motion is the drifting photo strip and a 180ms unfold on project details.
